subject: Audit traceability & BYOK/KMS evidence — narrow-gap review
messages:
From: Claire Rios <claire.rios@clearwellhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@clearwellhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit evidence: BYOK/KMS traceability questions

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC2 readiness review we hit a few edge cases in Redwood's BYOK/KMS support where our auditors are asking for concrete audit-traceability examples. Specifically:

- Evidence that key-rotation events and temporary key escrow operations are recorded with full context (who, when, which tenant).
- Proof that SSO session bindings and KMS access correlate in logs for the same request IDs.
- Retention behavior: how long the KMS-related audit events live, and whether we can carve that retention for a pilot.

Can you share what artifacts Redwood can provide today (log samples, mapping of event names, retention policy text)? If you prefer, we can set a short call next week — our security lead (Alex) will join.

I've attached the auditors' evidence request (one-pager).

Claire
Security Compliance Manager
Clearwell Health
Attachments: clearwell-evidence-request-2028.pdf
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Rios <claire.rios@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Oct 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit evidence: BYOK/KMS traceability questions

Claire — thanks for the clear list. We can provide concrete artifacts, but there are a couple of scope clarifications before I pull together packs for your auditors:

1) "Key-rotation events" — do you need the low-level KMS audit stream or a Redacted example showing tenant id, rotation timestamp, actor id, and rotation reason?
2) "SSO session bindings" — is a mapping table (SSO session id -> request ids -> KMS call ids) acceptable, or do you need raw request traces?
3) Retention carveout — we can propose a temporary short-window retention for the pilot, but we need legal/procurement agreement for any deviation from standard logs retention.

I'll loop in Marissa and Karthik for product/ops details and propose a 30-minute slot next Tue to align on a mutual action plan.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Compliance Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Oct 2028 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit evidence: BYOK/KMS traceability questions

Spinning up some quick specifics from product side — tagging for Evelyn's reply to the customer:

- What we can deliver this week (artifact set):
  * Example audit stream CSV (redacted) showing rotation, creation, use, and escrow events (fields: timestamp, tenant_id, actor, event_type, request_id, kms_operation).
  * Event map doc that translates Redwood event names to typical auditor language.
  * Short summary of retention policies and where they are enforced (control owners).

- Constraints and proposed interim workarounds:
  * We currently redact certain identifiers in hosted logs. For pilot evidence we can provide a redacted CSV that preserves correlation IDs; full raw logs require a legal retention carveout.
  * If Clearwell needs session-to-KMS correlation for a given date range we can generate a one-off export tied to a mutual action plan and PO.

I'll attach a rough internal checklist of BYO/BYOX asks and which teams own each artifact (product/ops/security). Evelyn — happy to be the owner on the artifact pack.

Marissa
Sr. PM, Product Security
Redwood Inference
Attachments: internal-byo-asks.xlsx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Oct 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit evidence: BYOK/KMS traceability questions

Quick roadmap note from infra/serving runtime:

- We can add fine-grained audit events for keystore lifecycle (rotate, escrow-temp, escrow-release, use) as a staged change. Target for upstream rollout: Q1 2029. That would be the long-term fix for auditors who want canonical event names and unambiguous fields.
- For an interim pilot with Clearwell we can expose a per-tenant export (CSV) containing correlated request ids and KMS ops for a specified time window. Ops will need an explicit retention carveout and a scoped runbook.

Linking to the brief roadmap note here: https://redwood.internal/roadmap/keystore-2029 — we should set customer expectations that the full telemetry change is a roadmap deliverable, but we can do scoped exports sooner.

Jonas
Director, Serving Infrastructure
From: Claire Rios <claire.rios@clearwellhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@clearwellhealth.com>, procurement@clearwellhealth.com
Date: Mon, 23 Oct 2028 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit evidence: BYOK/KMS traceability questions

Thanks — that plan sounds workable. Two asks before we book the pilot run:

1) Can you draft a short mutual action plan (MAP) with owners, a 4-week timeline for the export, and the exact artifact list we will receive? We need this for our internal approvers.
2) We need suggested contract language for the temporary retention carveout (scope, dates, security controls during export). I've attached our procurement template to make drafting easier.

If we can get a MAP and a procurement-friendly clause, I'll route for expedited approval and confirm a PO for the scoped effort.

Claire
Attachments: procurement-template.docx
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Rios <claire.rios@clearwellhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Oct 2028 22:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit evidence: BYOK/KMS traceability questions — MAP and next steps

Claire / team — see a proposed MAP below; I assigned owners and a conservative 4-week window for the export and evidence pack. Please flag any changes.

Mutual Action Plan (proposed):
- Week 0 (sign-off & PO): Clearwell to confirm PO and procurement clause; Redwood legal to review (owner: Naomi Feldman).
- Week 1 (artifact generation): Product/ops generate redacted audit CSV + event map + retention statement (owner: Marissa Cole).
- Week 2 (internal review): Redwood security review and redact where required (owner: Karthik Iyer).
- Week 3 (export & handoff): Scoped export run and secure delivery; include MD5 checksums and transfer log (owner: Jonas Weber / Ops).
- Week 4 (audit Q&A window): Live Q&A with auditors; we will accept two follow-up requests for minor clarifications.

Artifacts to be delivered: redacted_audit_stream.csv, event_name_map.pdf, retention_statement.txt, export_procedure_summary.pdf.

Attachments: MAP_Clearwell_20281027.csv (CSV with owners, target dates, and checkpoint links).

Procurement language (draft for Naomi/legal): we propose a limited retention carveout clause that specifies exact tables/fields, start/end dates, and an obligation for Redwood to delete any temporary exports after delivery; we will provide a standard NS/SA addendum for the export. Naomi — can you produce a one-paragraph clause by EOD Tue?

Claire — once you confirm the MAP and PO path we'll route legal and schedule the export window. Thanks all for quick coordination.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Compliance Solutions
Redwood Inference
